title: Westfall
content: Westfall is a level 10 to 20 Alliance zone of failing farmland west of Elwynn Forest. The Defias Brotherhood and their harvest golems have overrun the farms, and the People's Militia works out of Sentinel Hill. It holds the entrance to the Deadmines and the long-running Defias questline, and Alliance players usually quest here right after Elwynn.

title: Loch Modan
content: Loch Modan is a level 10 to 20 dwarven zone east of Dun Morogh, built around a great lake and the Stonewrought Dam. Thelsamar is the quest hub. Troggs, kobolds, and the Dark Iron dwarves press in from the hills, and the Explorers' League digs at the Farstrider Lodge and Ironband's excavation site.

title: Silverpine Forest
content: Silverpine Forest is a level 10 to 20 Horde zone south of Tirisfal Glades, dark and worgen-haunted. The Sepulcher is the Forsaken quest hub, and Shadowfang Keep sits at its southern edge above Pyrewood Village. Dalaran's old magical dome once stood here, and the Dalaran mages still hold ruins in the east.

title: Ghostlands
content: Ghostlands is a level 10 to 20 blood elf zone south of Eversong Woods, scarred by the Scourge's march on Quel'Thalas. Tranquillien is the quest hub, and the Dead Scar cuts through the middle of the zone. It leads on to Zul'Aman and connects Silvermoon's territory to the rest of the Eastern Kingdoms.

title: Redridge Mountains
content: Redridge Mountains is a level 15 to 25 Alliance zone east of Elwynn Forest, centered on Lakeshire and its broken bridge. Blackrock orcs push down from Render's Camp in the north and gnolls hold the southern hills. It borders Duskwood to the south and the Burning Steppes far to the north.

title: Duskwood
content: Duskwood is a level 18 to 30 zone of permanent night south of Elwynn Forest, with Darkshire as its quest hub. Worgen, undead, and spiders roam the roads, and the Night Watch patrols nervously. It holds the Stalvan Mistmantle and Mor'Ladim questlines, Raven Hill Cemetery, and the entrance to Deadwind Pass in the east.

title: Hillsbrad Foothills
content: Hillsbrad Foothills is a level 20 to 30 contested zone below Alterac, famous for open world PvP between Tarren Mill and Southshore. The Forsaken hold Tarren Hill in the north and the Alliance hold Southshore on the coast. Durnholde Keep and the Syndicate occupy the eastern hills.

title: Wetlands
content: Wetlands is a level 20 to 30 Alliance-leaning zone of marsh and rain north of Dun Morogh, with Menethil Harbor as its port and quest hub. Raptors, murlocs, and crocolisks make the roads dangerous for the level range. Boats from Menethil run to Theramore in Kalimdor and to Howling Fjord in Northrend.

title: Arathi Highlands
content: Arathi Highlands is a level 30 to 40 contested zone of open grassland, with Refuge Pointe for the Alliance and Hammerfall for the Horde. Stromgarde Keep lies ruined in the southwest, contested by the Syndicate and Boulderfist ogres. The Arathi Basin battleground takes its name and setting from this zone.

title: Alterac Mountains
content: Alterac Mountains is a level 30 to 40 contested snow zone between Hillsbrad and the Hinterlands. The ruins of Alterac city are held by the Syndicate, and yetis and ogres fill the valleys. It is thinly quested compared to its neighbours, and its main draw is the entrance to Alterac Valley in the north.

title: Stranglethorn Vale
content: Stranglethorn Vale is a level 30 to 45 contested jungle at the south end of the Eastern Kingdoms, notorious for world PvP along its single road. Booty Bay in the far south is a neutral goblin port with an auction house. Grom'gol Base Camp serves the Horde, Rebel Camp the Alliance, and Zul'Gurub sits in the eastern jungle.

title: Badlands
content: Badlands is a level 35 to 45 contested canyon zone south of Loch Modan, all red rock and dust. Kargath serves the Horde and the Dwarven District of Thelsamar supplies the Alliance side from the north. Its main feature is the entrance to Uldaman, and black dragonkin and Dark Iron dwarves contest the excavation sites.

title: Swamp of Sorrows
content: Swamp of Sorrows is a level 35 to 45 contested marsh east of Duskwood, sunk in permanent fog and rain. Stonard is the Horde outpost, and the Alliance has no real foothold. The Sunken Temple lies beneath the Temple of Atal'Hakkar in the north of the zone, and the Dark Portal sits just east in the Blasted Lands.

title: The Hinterlands
content: The Hinterlands is a level 40 to 50 contested forest north of the Plaguelands, home to the Wildhammer dwarves at Aerie Peak and the Revantusk trolls on the eastern coast. Vilebranch and Witherbark forest trolls hold most of the zone. Aerie Peak is also the entrance to Seradane and a common Alliance flight point.

title: Searing Gorge
content: Searing Gorge is a level 43 to 50 contested zone of ash and open flame between the Badlands and the Burning Steppes. The Thorium Brotherhood works out of Thorium Point, and the Dark Iron dwarves hold the Slag Pit and Blackrock. It is the surface approach to Blackrock Depths and a prime mining zone for thorium.

title: Blasted Lands
content: Blasted Lands is a level 45 to 55 contested wasteland at the southern tip of the Eastern Kingdoms, and it holds the Dark Portal to Outland. Nethergarde Keep serves the Alliance and Dreadmaul Hold the Horde. Players crossing to Outland at level 58 pass through here, so the zone stays busy well past its own level range.

title: Burning Steppes
content: Burning Steppes is a level 50 to 58 contested zone of lava and black rock, north of Redridge and below Blackrock Mountain. Morgan's Vigil holds the Alliance camp and Flame Crest the Horde. The zone is the front door to Blackrock Spire and Molten Core, and Dark Iron dwarves and black dragonkin patrol the roads.

title: Western Plaguelands
content: Western Plaguelands is a level 51 to 58 contested zone of Scourge-blighted farmland, with Chillwind Camp for the Alliance and the Bulwark on the Horde approach. Andorhal lies ruined at its center and Hearthglen in the north is held by the Scarlet Crusade. Scholomance sits on Caer Darrow in the southeast.

title: Eastern Plaguelands
content: Eastern Plaguelands is a level 53 to 60 contested zone and the darkest ground in the Eastern Kingdoms, with the Argent Dawn holding Light's Hope Chapel against the Scourge. Stratholme lies in the northwest behind its gates, and Naxxramas floated above the zone before it moved to Northrend. The plaguewood and Blackwood are thick with undead.

title: Deadwind Pass
content: Deadwind Pass is a level 55 to 60 contested corridor between Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows, and it has almost no quests of its own. Its reason to exist is Karazhan, Medivh's tower, which looms over the southern end of the pass and is the entry raid of the Burning Crusade.

title: Isle of Quel'Danas
content: Isle of Quel'Danas is a level 70 daily quest island north of Quel'Thalas, added at the end of the Burning Crusade. Both factions share the Shattered Sun Offensive base there, and the zone unlocks progressively through server-wide phases. It holds Magisters' Terrace and the Sunwell Plateau raid.
